query:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (i.id) i.id, i.name, i.width, i.height
                FROM images i
                WHERE EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM wd_tag_images wti
                    JOIN wd_tags wt ON wt.id = wti.wd_tag_id
                    WHERE wti.image_id = i.id
                        AND wt.name ~* ANY($1::TEXT[])
                        AND NOT wt.name ~* ANY($2::TEXT[])
                )
            LIMIT $3 OFFSET $4
